# SDOS 2026 — GitHub Copilot instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first. It is the repository's single working
agreement and defines the source of truth, platform invariants, verification
policy, skills workflow, and completion-report format.

The canonical project skills are in `.opencode/skills/`; `.github/skills/` is a
symlink to that directory. Select applicable skills as required by `AGENTS.md`.
